ops.title: Remove redundant mise activation from login zsh startup
ops.description: Trace shows high mise metadata traffic. Current zshenv and zprofile both activate shims on login. Proposed non-login guard retains profile activation after macOS path_helper, all non-login routing, interactive activation, and remote Go priority. Home-config change awaits independent review and root runtime/verification grant. Evidence fundamental-efficiency/mise-launch-metadata-performance.json.

ops.text: Independent startup-order review preserves login and non-login selected tool priority
